theory.title: Modales de pasado: deducción y arrepentimiento
theory.explanation: Usa might have o could have + participio para hablar de posibilidades pasadas. Usa must have para una deducción firme y can't have para algo que consideras imposible. Should have expresa crítica o arrepentimiento por una acción pasada.
theory.tip: Might/could have = quizá ocurrió; must have = casi seguro que ocurrió; can't have = no pudo ocurrir; should have = debería haberlo hecho.

content.passage: When the training application closed, Sam realised he had forgotten to attach his certificate. He should have checked the documents more carefully. The website might have saved a draft, but he could not find one. His colleague said the office must have received many applications that week. Sam was disappointed, but he decided to contact the training team. They explained that he could apply for the next course. He learned that a simple checklist could have prevented the problem.

items.prompt: Describe a mistake you learned from and what you should have done.
items.modelAnswer: I once sent a report without checking the figures in the final table. My manager noticed the mistake before it was shared with clients. I should have checked each number against the original document and asked a colleague to review it.

items.prompt: Explain what skills you can use confidently and which you want to improve.
items.modelAnswer: I'm confident using spreadsheets and explaining information to a group. I would like to improve my ability to negotiate, because I sometimes agree too quickly. Practising difficult conversations would help me at work.

items.prompt: Talk about the amount of information or equipment needed for a project.
items.modelAnswer: For a small research project, we need a clear question, reliable sources and a shared folder for our notes. We don't need expensive equipment, but we do need enough time to check the information carefully.

items.prompt: Describe a rule that must be followed at work or in a classroom.
items.modelAnswer: In a classroom, everyone must respect the safety instructions and let other students concentrate. For example, phones should be silent during presentations. These rules create a fair environment for the whole group.

items.prompt: Explain how you would prepare for an important deadline.
items.modelAnswer: I would prepare for a deadline by dividing the work into stages and setting an earlier date for the first draft. I would check what other people need from me and leave time to correct mistakes before submitting it.

items.prompt: Talk about a time when you managed to solve a difficult problem.
items.modelAnswer: Our team had trouble finding a missing order. I checked the delivery records, called the supplier and discovered that the parcel had been sent to the wrong address. We arranged a new delivery and informed the customer.

items.prompt: Describe how your work or study routine has changed.
items.modelAnswer: My study routine is more organised than it used to be. I now review my notes for twenty minutes after each lesson instead of trying to learn everything before an exam. I remember more this way.

items.prompt: Explain what you might have done differently in a past situation.
items.modelAnswer: I might have avoided a difficult situation if I had asked for clarification before starting the task. I assumed I understood the instructions, but I missed an important detail. Next time, I will confirm the requirements.

items.prompt: Give advice to someone starting a new course or job.
items.modelAnswer: If you are starting a course, read the course information and check what materials you need. Introduce yourself to your tutor and classmates, organise a weekly study time and ask for help early.

items.prompt: Summarise the most useful thing you have learned in this unit.
items.modelAnswer: The most useful lesson has been that good preparation prevents many problems. Clear instructions, realistic deadlines and regular communication help people work together. When something goes wrong, taking responsibility makes it easier to improve.
